subject: Request: minor supplier onboarding — authorization lane proposal
messages:
From: Elena Novak <elena@tinytools.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick onboarding question — PO required?

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo last week — TinyTools is excited to pilot Redwood for our CI cost-analysis workflow. Before we kick off, a quick operational question: our billing contact prefers to receive monthly invoices (net 30) rather than submit a purchase order. The first-year spend estimate is about $9,600 (monthly subscription). Is Redwood able to onboard a small supplier on invoice-only terms, or do we need to generate a PO?

I attached our vendor intake (pdf) and a signed W-9. If a PO is required, can you share the vendor form your procurement team needs?

Best,
Elena Novak
Head of Partnerships, TinyTools
attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf, W9_tinytools_signed.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Quick onboarding question — PO required?

Hi team — forwarding TinyTools' ask. Short summary:
- TinyTools wants invoice-only onboarding for a small subscription (~$800/mo).
- They provided vendor intake + W-9.

Request: Can we evaluate a temporary "minor-supplier authorization lane" for startups/subscriptions under $10k ARR that allows invoice-only for the first 12 months, subject to evidence and risk checks? This would avoid friction for PLG-style vendors and speed pilots.

Why it matters: TinyTools is a referenceable partner for dev-tools integrations; low revenue but high strategic value. If procurement approves an exception we can complete onboarding today.

Attached their forms in this thread. Happy to justify further — copying Laura and Hannah for intake checklist and scoring.

Thanks,
Marcus
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf, W9_tinytools_signed.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick onboarding question — PO required?

Marcus — thanks for the context and for attaching the forms. A couple of quick requests before we can consider an exception:

1) Confirmed W-9 received (good).
2) We need a short risk memo from your stakeholder (1–2 bullets): intended use case, data classification (any PII?), and expected monthly spend.
3) TinyTools must accept the standard vendor security attestation (we'll request SOC2 summary if they claim one).
4) If we approve an invoice-only lane, it will be temporary (90 days) and contingent on: no data residency needs, no custom integration with customer data planes, and a single point of contact for billing.

If you can provide the risk memo I will route a Procurement Exception Authorization (PEA) to Hannah for approval. Also attaching the vendor intake checklist we use.

Laura
Sr. Manager, Procurement Operations
attachments: procure_approval_sheet.xlsx

--
Laura Bennett
Redwood Inference — Procurement

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick onboarding question — PO required?

Thanks Laura — see risk memo below (copied into the body per your ask):

*Intended use case:* TinyTools will connect to anonymized CI usage metrics (no customer PII) to provide cost and CI optimization suggestions for dev teams. Pilot limited to our public sample repo and an opt-in internal pilot group of 3 teams.
*Data classification:* non-sensitive telemetry and anonymized repo metadata — no secrets, no customer personal data.
*Expected spend:* ~$800/month for first 12 months (~$9.6k).

They have confirmed no hosted data plane integrations and will use SSO link only for demo access. TinyTools indicated SOC2 Type II evidence is available — they will provide a summary link if needed. Billing contact is accounts@tinytools.io and prefers monthly invoices net-30.

Given the low financial exposure and limited scope, I recommend approving a temporary 90-day invoice-only onboarding (with an option to extend to 12 months if security evidence arrives). Please escalate to Hannah for approval.

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Dec 2026 16:47:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Fwd: Quick onboarding question — PO required?

Marcus/Laura — reviewed the memo and attachments. Approved a temporary Minor Supplier Authorization Lane for TinyTools under the following conditions:

1) Invoice-only onboarding approved for an initial 90-day period starting on the invoice date.
2) Accounts payable to issue invoice terms net-30 to accounts@tinytools.io; finance to create vendor record but tag as "temp-invoice-lane".
3) TinyTools must provide SOC2 summary link within 30 days; failure to provide will revert the account to PO-required workflow.
4) No production data integrations or custom connectors during the pilot window.

Laura — please complete the PEA form and update JIRA (JIRA-PROC-327). Marcus — please copy the TinyTools billing address into the vendor record and confirm once AP has a vendor ID.

Thanks — Hannah
Head of Procurement Strategy
attachments: procure_approval_sheet.xlsx

--
Hannah Schmitt
Redwood Inference — Procurement Strategy
